name: lodestar-pro-modules
description: Premium modules and nav styles for Lodestar (parallax, chart, tourDates and untangle modules, mega nav with 8 presets, section motion). Installed per-project via install.mjs — not baked into the base template. Requires lodestar >= 0.2.0; section motion needs the SectionRenderer hook added after lodestar 0.4.0.
